integrity: The proof classifies which coordinate inequalities are genuine facets, computes their intrinsic projected normal length, proves three sharp universal upper barriers, constructs a matching center using the interval-sum criterion, and then reads off every optimal center from the normalized actual-facet clearances. Finite active-set replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns thin rectangular-prism slices in their standard coordinate Euclidean realization, with dimension at least two. It does not assert metric invariance under the source's integral equivalence with fat slices and does not determine minimum enclosing spheres or extremal ellipsoids. A general affine-box-section Chebyshev theorem under different terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Thin slices of rectangular prisms have a three-barrier Euclidean inradius
